description: Perform a comparative analysis of VPS pricing for small businesses in 2024. Compare AWS Lightsail, DigitalOcean, Linode, and Hetzner specifically for mid-tier plans (2-4 vCPU, 4-8GB RAM). The analysis must include regional pricing for US and EU, a breakdown of managed vs unmanaged costs, and available scalability options.
expected_output: A comprehensive Markdown article containing a comparative analysis and pricing tables, stored as a finalized post.
search_prompt: 2024 VPS pricing comparison small business AWS Lightsail vs DigitalOcean vs Linode vs Hetzner mid-tier plans 2-4 vCPU 4-8GB RAM US vs EU pricing managed vs unmanaged costs scalability options
title: Comparative Analysis of VPS Pricing for Small Businesses 2024
